title: colubrina verrucosa
intro: Colubrina verrucosa, commonly known as the " Rough Boxwood" or "Palo de Palo", is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of Colubrina verrucosa include antioxidant, antiparasitic, and cardiotonic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
